Signed time-boxed token authentication
Every API call except login requires a valid signed token; credentials never returned. Source: NFR-DA-SEC-01; FR-DA-RBAC-06.
Server-side RBAC and Pack entitlement enforcement
Each route checks permission and Pack/Add-On entitlement independently at the server; either may return 403. Source: NFR-DA-SEC-03; NFR-DA-SEC-09; FR-DA-RBAC-03; FR-DA-CFG-06.
License Expiry Prevention
Licence expiry is checked on every start and login; warning at 30 days, read-only at expiry. Source: D30 Licensing Implementation Schema; RULE-LIC-002.
Salted password hashing
Passwords stored only as salted hashes; plaintext never logged. Source: NFR-DA-SEC-02.
Parameterized data access
All queries use parameterized statements; no concatenation of untrusted input. Source: NFR-DA-SEC-04.
Owner/Evaluator segregation of duties
Owner and evaluator of an action must differ, enforced at the server. Source: NFR-DA-SEC-05; FR-DA-RBAC-04.
Single Accountable per RACSI activity
Database constraint allows at most one Accountable per activity. Source: NFR-DA-SEC-06; FR-DA-GOV-07.
Client-side-only LLM and integration credentials
LLM API keys stay client-side and are used for one call only; integration credentials are encrypted references, never logged. Source: NFR-DA-SEC-07; FR-DA-AI-08; FR-DA-CFG-11.
Server-side quota enforcement
Every Pack-bound quota is checked at creation; over-quota returns HTTP 409, never partial. Source: NFR-DA-SEC-08; FR-DA-TEN-07.
Restricted individual-level visibility
Individual assessments, coaching notes and evaluation verdicts are visible only to named roles; others see aggregates. Source: NFR-DA-SEC-10; FR-DA-RBAC-09.
Automated cross-tenant access test suite
The release pipeline runs cross-tenant tests; a failure blocks the release. Source: NFR-DA-SEC-11; FR-DA-TEN-08.
Login rate limiting and security headers
Login is rate-limited per client; responses carry nosniff, frame and cross-origin headers. Source: NFR-DA-SEC-12.
Tenant isolation of caches, backups and logs
Backups stored outside web-served paths, readable only by service account and platform administrator; read cache per user, max 30 s. Source: NFR-DA-SEC-13; NFR-DA-PERF-05.
Performance service-level monitoring
Monitors list render <= 2 s, AI suggestion <= 5 s, search <= 1 s, export <= 3 s, P95 read <= 1 s at 100 users. Source: NFR-DA-PERF-01; NFR-DA-PERF-02; NFR-DA-PERF-03; NFR-DA-PERF-04; NFR-DA-PERF-05.
AI graceful degradation
On live-call failure the deterministic result is served and the CRUD operation still succeeds. Source: NFR-DA-REL-01; FR-DA-AI-09; FR-DA-KB-04.
License File Integrity Check (Ed25519)
Licence file signature verified with the vendor's Ed25519 public key (OnPrem) or HMAC (SaaS) before activation. Source: D30 Licensing Implementation Schema; RULE-LIC-001.
Add-On Activation Integrity Check (idempotency + disclosure)
Repeated activation creates no duplicate scaffold; the non-certification disclosure cannot be suppressed. Source: D30 Section 2.1; RULE-LIC-004; FR-DA-CFG-05; FR-DA-CFG-09; NFR-DA-COMP-04.
Uptime monitoring
Health endpoint polled; availability reported against 99.9% target. Source: NFR-DA-REL-02; FR-DA-OPS-06.
Export failure integrity
A failed export returns a structured error and never alters report data. Source: NFR-DA-REL-03.
Backup schedule and restore test
Daily backup bounds data loss to 24 h; retention 14 days; restore tested each release. Source: NFR-DA-REL-04; NFR-DA-REL-05; FR-DA-OPS-01; FR-DA-OPS-02; FR-DA-OPS-03.
Scalability load test gate

Each release load-tested at 100 concurrent users per tenant; web and API tiers scaled independently; persistence and index swappable behind the API. Source: NFR-DA-SCALE-01; NFR-DA-SCALE-02; NFR-DA-SCALE-03.
Visual identity conformance
Generated documents and UI use the suite palette, typography and one status badge vocabulary. Source: NFR-DA-UX-01; NFR-DA-UX-04; FR-DA-REP-02.
Responsive layout and touch targets
Core workflows usable on mobile viewport; targets >= 24 px, >= 44 px on touch. Source: NFR-DA-UX-02; NFR-DA-UX-05; NFR-DA-COMPAT-03.
Automated accessibility scan
axe-core scan with no critical or serious violation; AA contrast; translated, announced notifications. Source: NFR-DA-UX-03; NFR-DA-UX-06; NFR-DA-UX-07.
Arabic RTL rendering check
Navigation, tables and charts verified mirrored under Arabic. Source: NFR-DA-I18N-01; FR-DA-I18N-04.
Installability and startup guards

Install with Node.js only; startup guards report runtime, port and empty store in plain language; additive migrations. Source: NFR-DA-PORT-01; NFR-DA-PORT-02; NFR-DA-PORT-04; FR-DA-OPS-04; FR-DA-OPS-05.
Cross-OS continuous integration gate
CI on Linux, Windows and macOS installs, seeds, tests and builds each change. Source: NFR-DA-PORT-03.
Composable engine and AI interface review
Shared engines reusable by sibling apps; AI behind a stable interface; one LLM integration point. Source: NFR-DA-MAINT-01; NFR-DA-MAINT-02; NFR-DA-MAINT-04.
Single entitlement matrix
Pack feature and quota matrix defined once and consumed by every route. Source: NFR-DA-MAINT-03; FR-DA-CFG-01.
Single alert catalog
Alert names and stage mapping defined in one module used by seed and live computation. Source: NFR-DA-MAINT-05; FR-DA-ALT-01.
Documentation generated from source
Installation and User Guides generated in Word and PDF with TOC; walkthroughs replayed on a fresh seed. Source: NFR-DA-MAINT-06.
